{
  "requests": [
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_001",
      "research_question": "In eukaryotic lagging-strand DNA replication, which enzymatic activities remove RNA primers, and are RNase H and flap endonuclease distinct or can one be used as a synonym for the other?",
      "required_claim": "A source passage that either distinguishes RNase H and flap endonuclease activities in eukaryotic lagging-strand primer removal, or unambiguously assigns primer removal to one named activity without equating them.",
      "biological_scope": "Eukaryotic nuclear DNA replication, lagging strand, primer removal step; organisms: general eukaryotes (e.g., Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Homo sapiens) as model systems.",
      "source_preferences": ["peer-reviewed review articles", "molecular biology textbooks", "primary research articles in PubMed Central"],
      "search_queries": [
        "eukaryotic lagging strand RNA primer removal RNase H flap endonuclease distinct roles",
        "RNase H versus flap endonuclease in Okazaki fragment maturation eukaryotes",
        "primer removal DNA replication eukaryotes RNase H FEN1 mechanism"
      ],
      "expected_evidence_type": "MECHANISM_DESCRIPTION"
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_002",
      "research_question": "Does DNA polymerase delta specifically receive the hand-off from DNA polymerase alpha on the lagging strand during eukaryotic DNA replication, or is this a simplification?",
      "required_claim": "A source passage stating that DNA polymerase alpha hands off specifically to DNA polymerase delta on the lagging strand (as opposed to a generic 'second polymerase').",
      "biological_scope": "Eukaryotic DNA replication, lagging strand synthesis; polymerase switching from pol alpha to pol delta.",
      "source_preferences": ["peer-reviewed review articles", "molecular biology textbooks", "primary research articles in PubMed Central"],
      "search_queries": [
        "DNA polymerase alpha to delta handoff lagging strand eukaryotic replication",
        "polymerase switching pol alpha pol delta lagging strand eukaryotes",
        "eukaryotic lagging strand synthesis polymerase delta receives primer from polymerase alpha"
      ],
      "expected_evidence_type": "MECHANISM_DESCRIPTION"
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_003",
      "research_question": "After RNA primer removal in eukaryotic lagging-strand replication, is there a distinct DNA replacement synthesis step that produces a nicked substrate for DNA ligase, or can ligase act directly on the gap left after primer removal?",
      "required_claim": "Either (a) a represented replacement-synthesis step (or explicit gap-filling product state) that produces the DNA-replaced, nicked substrate for ligation, or (b) a source statement that ligation can act on the gap state left after primer removal without a separate replacement step.",
      "biological_scope": "Eukaryotic lagging-strand maturation: primer removal, gap filling/replacement synthesis, and ligation.",
      "source_preferences": ["peer-reviewed review articles", "molecular biology textbooks", "primary research articles in PubMed Central"],
      "search_queries": [
        "eukaryotic Okazaki fragment maturation primer removal replacement synthesis ligation nick",
        "gap filling after RNA primer removal lagging strand DNA ligase substrate",
        "DNA ligase seals nick after primer replacement eukaryotic replication"
      ],
      "expected_evidence_type": "MECHANISM_DESCRIPTION"
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "ISS_004",
      "research_question": "When DNA polymerase delta encounters the RNA primer of the previous Okazaki fragment on the lagging strand, does it displace the primer into a single-stranded flap, and what is the physical state of the displaced primer before removal?",
      "required_claim": "A modeled displaced-primer state (e.g., primer RNA annealed to template vs. displaced single-stranded flap) that links the displacement event in POL_DELTA_EXTENSION to the removal target in PRIMER_REMOVAL.",
      "biological_scope": "Eukaryotic lagging-strand replication: pol delta strand displacement and primer flap formation.",
      "source_preferences": ["peer-reviewed review articles", "molecular biology textbooks", "primary research articles in PubMed Central"],
      "search_queries": [
        "DNA polymerase delta strand displacement RNA primer flap lagging strand eukaryotes",
        "Okazaki fragment primer displacement flap formation pol delta eukaryotic replication",
        "displaced RNA primer state during eukaryotic lagging strand synthesis"
      ],
      "expected_evidence_type": "MECHANISM_DESCRIPTION"
    },
    {
      "issue_id": "STATE_MODEL_MIGRATION",
      "research_question": "What are the supported pre-clip conditions, explicit subject/property/value states, and missing state producers for the user-required mechanisms of local eukaryotic DNA replication priming, extension, and one local maturation event (primer removal and ligation), excluding origins?",
      "required_claim": "Identify supported pre-clip conditions, explicit subject/property/value states and missing state producers without omitting user-required mechanisms. Preserve actual user teaching scope.",
      "biological_scope": "Eukaryotic DNA replication local events: priming by pol alpha-primase, extension by pol alpha then pol delta, primer removal (RNase H/flap endonuclease), and ligation; excludes origin licensing/firing.",
      "source_preferences": ["peer-reviewed review articles", "molecular biology textbooks", "primary research articles in PubMed Central"],
      "search_queries": [
        "eukaryotic DNA replication priming extension primer removal ligation state transitions",
        "local eukaryotic replication mechanisms pol alpha primase pol delta RNase H ligase states",
        "Okazaki fragment maturation state model priming extension removal ligation eukaryotes"
      ],
      "expected_evidence_type": "MECHANISM_DESCRIPTION"
    }
  ],
  "candidate_urls": [
    "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK26845/",
    "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC2811071/"
  ],
  "scientific_queries": [
    "eukaryotic lagging strand DNA replication primer removal RNase H flap endonuclease polymerase alpha delta handoff Okazaki fragment maturation ligation mechanism"
  ]
}
